description: This file defines functions and constants for normalizing media paths within reply payloads, including URL validation, sandbox resolution, and media source handling.

methods.name: isLikelyLocalMediaSource
methods.description: Determines if a media string is likely a local source based on URL schemes and path patterns.

methods.name: getPayloadMediaList
methods.description: Extracts media URLs from a reply payload using resolveSendableOutboundReplyParts.

methods.name: createReplyMediaPathNormalizer
methods.description: Creates a function that normalizes media paths in reply payloads, resolving sandbox sources and local paths.
